scope: M0 batch fallback operational identity, not native equivalence
one_worker: Exact float32 RGBA words including signed zero
twelve_workers: Freeze max over each reference/reference pair for every channel and metric. Each held-out original and fallback must pass against all five originals. No refit.
mode: Actual XPU, positive GPU intersection utilization, exact requested threads, no fallback/errors
cancellation: Cancelled child yields no output; fresh job recovers; settings-stale result rejected
limitations: Finite observed envelope is not a population confidence interval. A failing held-out original invalidates the envelope for qualification; retain failures.
